subject: Security review kickoff & systems scope — Nova Health
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novahealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: security kickoff items + inferred scope

Hi Laura — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everything is aligned: 

Recap (from our notes)
- Business goal: pilot Redwood Inference for clinical note summarization in a non-prod environment, then expand to inference in prod for select workflows.
- Key decision criteria you called out: data isolation, encryption at rest/in transit, SOC2 + pen test visibility, and predictable latency/SLAs for the inference path.
- Timeline: pilot gating decisions ~late April; procurement/legal review expected early–mid March.

Stakeholder map (please confirm/add):
- Laura Chen — Head of AI/Clinical (primary champion)
- Daniel Park — Procurement lead (you mentioned)
- Elena Morales — Security lead (you suggested loop-in for deep-dive)
- CISO (TBD) — final sign-off on prod rollout

Systems we believe are in scope (please correct):
1) Redwood-hosted inference API calls from Nova staging and prod (TLS, token auth)
2) Customer-provided S3 for long-term logs/metrics (encryption using your KMS)
3) VPC peering from Nova staging (optional) for private connectivity to dedicated pools
4) Embeddings/cache persistence in AWS RDS (non-PHI) + KV cache (memory-local on GPU hosts)

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Can you share security contact(s) and procurement contact email so we can route the questionnaire? (we've attached an initial security questionnaire worksheet)
- Confirm systems in scope and any additional vendors (e.g., identity provider, logging sinks) by EOD Wed 3/4 if possible.
- We propose a 60-minute security deep-dive with your SecOps and Procurement next week — what windows work for Elena / Daniel?
- If helpful, we can circulate a mutual NDA prior to sharing SOC2 artifacts (we can have our legal lead, Stephanie, draft).

Attached: security-questionnaire-v1.xlsx (worksheet with intake & checklist)

Thanks — I’ll coordinate calendars after I get your preferred contacts.

—
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Hi Daniel / Elena — great to be connected. Per Laura's note, I’m sending the security intake worksheet so your team can indicate which items are in-scope and add any missing systems. Quick notes:

- Attached a filled starter sheet (security-questionnaire-v1.xlsx) with our initial assumptions from the call. Please edit tab "Scope" and the network diagram tab where relevant.
- We generally store logs encrypted at rest in customer S3 when requested; default telemetry is aggregated and retained 30 days for pilot unless you request otherwise.
- For faster review of SOC2 artifacts we can provide a redacted report after an NDA. Stephanie (cc’d) is our legal lead and can circulate a mutual NDA; I attached a stub for quick review.

Proposed agenda for the 60-minute deep-dive (feel free to modify):
1) Introductions & roles (10m)
2) High-level architecture & data flows (15m)
3) Access controls, encryption, KMS options (15m)
4) Auditing, logging, retention, and breach response (10m)
5) Next steps, artifacts, and procurement milestones (10m)

Please confirm availability (we have open slots Tue 3/9 9–11am PT or Wed 3/10 1–4pm PT). If you prefer a different cadence, let us know.

Attachments: security-questionnaire-v1.xlsx; mutual-NDA-Redwood-Nova-2026.pdf

Thanks — looking forward.

—
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Security questionnaire + proposed NDA (technical clarifications + agenda tweaks)

Thanks Monica — adding a few technical clarifications to prep the deep-dive: 

- Data flows: inference requests go to Redwood’s inference frontend over TLS. Requests can be routed to hosted models (Redwood-managed) or to a Dedicated pool in your VPC.
- KV cache: per-host in-memory cache to accelerate repeated contexts; not persisted to customer buckets unless explicitly configured.
- Logs & metrics: application logs (sanitized) can be written to your S3 using our IAM role with SSE-KMS. We can support using your KMS for S3 buckets.
- Retention: pilot default 30 days for temp traces; production config is customer-controlled (30, 90, 365 days).
- Pen test / SOC2: we can share redacted SOC2 Type II and our most recent penetration test summary under NDA.

Suggested tweak to agenda: extend architecture slot to 20m and add 5m for mapping procurement deliverables (e.g., PO template, billing contacts).

Happy to expand any item in the doc prior to the call — I can draft the network diagram if you share VPC CIDRs.

—Aditya
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
